social_world.value: Publishing industry hierarchy: large conglomerate giants (Random House, Viking, Hachette, Simon & Schuster) vs. independent mid-size literary houses (Houghton Mifflin, Harcourt); editorial independence vs. commercial pressure networks.
social_world.quote: No editor or executive has knocked on the door to offer "suggestions" about changes, no memos have appeared in the mailbox

media_and_audience.value: The anthology foreword explicitly addresses how mystery fiction is publicly perceived and packaged — dismissed by erudite readers as mere entertainment versus 'good' literary fiction — and how marketing categorisation shapes audience reception of the genre.
media_and_audience.quote: There are folks who fancy themselves too erudite to try a volume of mystery stories. They believe that one is mere entertainment
